name: validator-starting-contract

payload.valueRule: One or more lowercase ASCII words separated by exactly one ordinary space; no leading or trailing space.

authority: This is a provisional team contract, not a fixed user requirement. Inspect your own starting contract independently. If a conflict is discovered, report the exact difference and participate in a genuinely agreed resolution; do not prescribe another member's proposal mechanism or speak/vote on their behalf.
completion: Independently validate the agreed final payload and record concise evidence. A small useful test set is enough; do not build a general-purpose JSON conformance framework.
